up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL2403108 (CERITINIB) and all its salts. Use the molecule_hierarchy table starting from CHEMBL2403108 to find the parent molecule and all related salts/derivatives. Filter for IC50 bioactivity values (standard_type = 'IC50') with units in nM. Filter for target CHEMBL4247 (ALK tyrosine kinase receptor). Return exactly these columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id from docs, fallback to doi), assay_description (from assays), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (from activities), target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary), target_name (pref_name from target_dictionary), and target_organism (organism from target_dictionary). Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH target_active AS (
  SELECT mh.active_molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON mh.molregno = md.molregno
  WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2403108'
),
target_family AS (
  SELECT mh.molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN target_active ta ON mh.active_molregno = ta.active_molregno
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN target_family tf ON a.molregno = tf.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4247'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
